Sauna Before or After a Workout?

Use the sauna after your workout. Heat before training raises your heart rate and starts the sweating you need for the session itself, while a 15 to 20 minute sauna afterward is how the main studies used it, including a 2022 trial where adding 15 minutes post-exercise lowered blood pressure more than exercise alone.
